d: Short, spiky ash-blonde hair peeks from under a hood, paired with sharp, narrow golden eyes and a youthful, mature expression. The build is slender, clad in a black tactical ensemble featuring a hooded jacket, dark trousers, and silver armored plating on the legs, accented by a long, flowing black and teal cloak. A large, stylized silver spear is held in one hand, while a massive, robotic mechanical horse with dark grey plating and glowing cyan accents stands beside.
